svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Anatomy of a 3D surface plot
svg.desc: A 3D surface plot of temperature across a 40 by 30 cm metal plate, drawn as a coloured mesh above a flat floor. Numbered markers show the highest peak at 81 °C, a lower peak at 64 °C, the saddle between them at 43 °C, the steep slope at the cooled edge, a flat area near room temperature, one grid cell between four data points, the far side of the tall peak that is hidden from this angle, and a colour scale where colour repeats the height.
svg.text: Steep slope at the cooled edge
One grid cell between four data points
